Ranarr seeds can be planted in a herb patch at level 32 Farming to yield grimy ranarr weed, which, when cleaned, are used in Herblore to make potions.

Nearby gardeners will not watch over herb patches, nor will a fully-grown white lily plant protect them from disease.

They are obtainable from sources such as monsters, seed packs, and master farmers. Other sources include high-level gambling at the Barbarian Assault minigame, Larran's big chest, and Managing Miscellania (if residents are assigned to farming).

Herb running ranarr seeds is profitable if disease chance is minimised and yield is maximised. Use ultracompost, or the enhanced Fertile Soil spell, to reduce disease and increase the average yield. Plant anima seeds, iasor to reduce disease chance, and attas to increase yield. Equip the Farming cape and have magic secateurs equipped or in the inventory when harvesting to increase yield.

It is also recommended to utilise disease-free patches in five locations:

  • Troll Stronghold after completing My Arm's Big Adventure
  • Hosidius patch after completing the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary
  • Weiss, after building the Fire of Nourishment fire pit
  • Outer Fortis after obtaining 16,000 Glory at the Fortis Colosseum
  • Harmony Island, accessible after completing the Elite Morytania Diary

Average harvest yield

[edit | edit source]

Ranarr weed has a minimum of 3 harvest lives, increasing by 1 for each tier of compost used (for a maximum of 6 when using ultracompost). While harvesting ranarr weed, there is a chance to not consume a harvest life dependent on the player's Farming level. This chance scales from 15.6% at level 1 to 31.6% at level 99, interpolating linearly in between.

Changes

[edit | edit source]
Date Changes
23 July 2020
(Update | poll)

The appearance of herbs planted in herb patches now match the herb's appearance in the player's inventory.

9 January 2020
(Update | poll)

Players can now dig up healthy herb patches before they're fully grown. To prevent players from gaining experience repeatedly by planting and digging up herb seeds, the experience usually gained from planting them is now given when harvesting them, alongside the usual harvesting experience.

8 February 2018
(Update | poll)

The value was changed from 19 to 50 so that it would appear above less valuable seeds when on the ground.

9 – 23 August 2005
  • The item was renamed from "Herb seed" to "Ranarr seed".
  • The item's examine was changed from "A herb seed - plant in a herb patch." to "A ranarr seed - plant in a herb patch."
11 July 2005
(Update)

The item's examine was changed from "Farming skill coming in July!" to "A herb seed - plant in a herb patch."
